result.reason: The clause adds the preferred 30-day Customer notice and 60-day Vendor reminder, but omits any price-increase cap, so it reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. It also frames the notice as a general termination right exercisable on any specified date, rather than notice of non-renewal effective at an anniversary, potentially expanding the Customer’s termination right beyond what the renewal playbook requires. If the fallback’s 60-day maximum applies bilaterally, HDI’s retained 90-day window is also noncompliant. The drafting should use “days’ prior written notice” and expressly tie non-renewal to the end of the then-current term.
